name: Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp II
summary: As of August 27, 2026, Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II was acquired by Pasqal SAS, in a reverse merger transaction. Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. II focuses on effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is based in New York, New York.
